title: Discovery of NSD2 non-histone substrates and design of a super-substrate.
authors: Weirich, Sara; Kusevic, Denis; Schnee, Philipp; Reiter, Jessica; Pleiss, Jurgen; Jeltsch, Albert
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甲基转移酶NSD2的底物特异性与超底物设计，虽涉及酶-肽复合物MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-肽而非蛋白-DNA互作，仅间接关联DNA修复，与本课题TF-DNA互作核心无关。
abstract: The human protein lysine methyltransferase NSD2 catalyzes dimethylation at H3K36. It has very important roles in development and disease but many mechanistic features and its full spectrum of substrate proteins are unclear. Using peptide SPOT array methylation assays, we investigate the substrate sequence specificity of NSD2 and discover strong readout of residues between G33 (-3) and P38 (+2) on H3K36. Unexpectedly, we observe that amino acid residues different from natural ones in H3K36 are preferred at some positions. Combining four preferred residues led to the development of a super-substrate which is methylated much faster by NSD2 at peptide and protein level. Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrate that this activity increase is caused by distinct hyperactive conformations of the enzyme-peptide complex. To investigate the substrate spectrum of NSD2, we conducted a proteome wide search for nuclear proteins matching the specificity profile and discovered 22 peptide substrates of NSD2. In protein methylation studies, we identify K1033 of ATRX and K819 of FANCM as NSD2 methylation sites and also demonstrate their methylation in human cells. Both these proteins have important roles in DNA repair strengthening the connection of NSD2 and H3K36 methylation to DNA repair.
abstract_zh: 人源蛋白赖氨酸甲基转移酶NSD2催化H3K36位点的二甲基化。它在发育和疾病中具有非常重要的作用，但许多机制特征及其完整的底物蛋白谱尚不清楚。利用肽SPOT阵列甲基化测定，我们研究了NSD2的底物序列特异性，并发现其对H3K36上G33（-3）至P38（+2）之间的残基具有强烈的读取效应。出乎意料的是，我们观察到在某些位置上，与H3K36天然氨基酸不同的残基更受偏好。结合四种优选残基，我们开发了一种超底物，其在肽和蛋白水平上被NSD2甲基化的速度显著加快。分子动力学模拟表明，这种活性增加是由酶-肽复合物的不同超活性构象引起的。为了探究NSD2的底物谱，我们进行了蛋白质组范围内的搜索，寻找符合该特异性谱的核蛋白，并发现了22种NSD2的肽底物。在蛋白甲基化研究中，我们确定ATRX的K1033和FANCM的K819为NSD2的甲基化位点，并进一步证明了它们在人类细胞中的甲基化。这两种蛋白在DNA修复中具有重要作用，加强了NSD2和H3K36甲基化与DNA修复之间的联系。
